function ld takes unit u,unit Jd returns nothing
	local player p=GetOwningPlayer(Jd)
	local integer GI=GetPlayerId(p)
	local boolean kd=GetUnitAbilityLevel(Jd,'B01K')>0
	local group sg
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DZ')>0)then
		call ShowUnit(u,false)
		call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,$D02BB)
		call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',1.)
	endif
	if(kd)then
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09M')
		call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A09M',3)
		call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A09M')
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09Q')
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09R')
	endif
	call gB(u)
	set Mi[GI]=Mi[GI]+1
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07M')>=1)then
		call NB(u)
		call GroupAddUnit(er,u)
	elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A09H')>0)then
		call jd(CreateUnit(p,GetUnitTypeId(u),GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),.0),Jd)
	elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0FO')>0)then
		call jd(CreateUnit(p,'n02K',GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),.0),Jd)
		call jd(CreateUnit(p,'n02L',GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),.0),Jd)
	endif
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A070')<=0)then
		set bj_lastCreatedUnit=u
		set bj_lastLoadedUnit=Jd
		set bj_forLoopAIndex=0
		call ForGroup(Hi[ea[GI]],function Kd)
	endif
	if(Ei)then
		set sg=LoadGroupHandle(Gr,'SyGr',GetHandleId(Jd))
		if(sg!=null)then
			set nr=GetUnitBuildTime(GetUnitTypeId(u))
			call ForGroup(sg,function Hd)
			set sg=null
			call TriggerSleepAction(.3)
			call PauseUnit(Jd,true)
			call TriggerSleepAction(.3)
			call PauseUnit(Jd,false)
		endif
	endif
	set sg=null
endfunction

	local player p=GetOwningPlayer(Jd)

	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DZ')>0)then

handlers.name: BloodFiendRandom
handlers.body:
function BloodFiendRandom takes unit u returns unit
	local integer i
	local integer array randspells
	local integer counter = 8
	local integer spell1
	local integer spell2

	set randspells[0] = 'A01B'
	set randspells[1] = 'A02B'
	set randspells[2] = 'A02B'
	set randspells[3] = 'A009'
	set randspells[4] = 'A05J'
	set randspells[5] = 'A01A'
	set randspells[6] = 'A00D'
	set randspells[7] = 'A01U'
	set randspells[8] = 'A012'

	set i = GetRandomInt(0, 99)
	if i < 30 then
		return u
	elseif (i < 40) then
		call BloodFiendCurse(u)
		return u
	endif

	set i = GetRandomInt(0, counter)
	set spell1 = randspells[i]
	if i == 0 or i == 1 then
		set randspells[0] = randspells[counter]
		set randspells[1] = randspells[counter - 1]
		set randspells[2] = randspells[counter - 2]
		set counter = counter - 3
	else
		set randspells[i] = randspells[counter]
		set counter = counter - 1
	endif

	set i = GetRandomInt(0, counter)
	set spell2 = randspells[i]

	//call DisplayTextToForce( GetPlayersAll(), GetAbilityName(spell1) )
	//call DisplayTextToForce( GetPlayersAll(), GetAbilityName(spell2) )

	call UnitAddAbility(u, spell1)
	call UnitAddAbility(u, spell2)

	return u
endfunction

	call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,false)
	call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',1.)
	set c=bj_groupRandomCurrentPick
	call TriggerSleepAction(1.)
	call cB(c)
	if(GetUnitTypeId(c)=='h03A')then
	call TriggerSleepAction(44.5)
	call IssueImmediateOrderById(c,$D0057)
	call TriggerSleepAction(.5)

	endif
	set c=null
	elseif(i==6)then
	set c=CreateUnit(Bv,'e008',GetUnitX(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),GetUnitY(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),.0)
	call UnitAddAbility(c,'A06S')
	call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,true)

	call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,false)

function WD takes nothing returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(kv)
local real x=GetUnitX(Kv)
local real y=GetUnitY(Kv)
local real sx=GetUnitX(kv)
local real sy=GetUnitY(kv)
local unit c=CreateUnit(p,'h06N',sx,sy,.0)
local unit t
if(ni)then
call II("SE:MC:SG "+GetUnitName(kv)+" ->[no target]")
call NI()
endif
call IssuePointOrderById(c,$D0010,x,y)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',3.)
set sx=sx-(x)
set sy=sy-(y)
call TriggerSleepAction(SquareRoot(sx*sx+sy*sy)/ 700.)
set c=CreateUnit(p,'e008',x,y,.0)
call UnitAddAbility(c,'A0FS')

loop
set t=FirstOfGroup(Nv)
exitwhen t==null
call GroupRemoveUnit(Nv,t)
set sx=GetUnitState(t,UNIT_STATE_MANA)
if(sx>.0)then
set sy=RMinBJ(sx,'d')
call SetUnitState(t,UNIT_STATE_MANA,sx-sy)
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Feedback\\SpellBreakerAttack.mdl",t,"origin"))
call UnitDamageTarget(c,t,sy,true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
endif
endloop
set c=null
set t=null
endfunction
